title: gynura divaricata subsp. formosana
intro: Gynura divaricata subsp. formosana, commonly known as Formosan gynura, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae, native to Taiwan. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Formosan gynura include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its effectiveness in treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Formosan gynura include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
